title: War with the Philistines and Capture of Rabbah

questions.question: What time of year did kings go out to battle?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:1 (ESV): "In the spring of the year, the time when kings go out to battle..."

questions.question: Who led the army to ravage the country of the Ammonites?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:1 (ESV): "...Joab led out the army and ravaged the country..."

questions.question: Where was David when Joab besieged Rabbah?
What did David take from the head of the king (or Milcom)?
options: A crown of gold with a precious stone
questions.correctAnswer: A crown of gold with a precious stone
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:2 (ESV): "And David took the crown of their king from his head... and in it was a precious stone..."

questions.question: Where was the crown placed?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:2 (ESV): "...and it was placed on David's head."

questions.question: Who killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the giants?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:4 (ESV): "...Sibbecai the Hushathite killed Sippai, one of the descendants of the giants..."

questions.question: Who killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:5 (ESV): "...Elhanan the son of Jair killed Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite..."

questions.question: What was distinctive about Lahmi’s spear?
options: The shaft was like a weaver's beam
questions.correctAnswer: The shaft was like a weaver's beam
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:5 (ESV): "...the shaft of whose spear was like a weaver's beam."

questions.question: What physical anomaly did the giant at Gath have?
options: Six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot (24 in all)
questions.correctAnswer: Six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot (24 in all)
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:6 (ESV): "...a man of great stature, who had six fingers on each hand and six toes on each foot, twenty-four in number..."

questions.question: Who killed this giant with 24 digits?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:7 (ESV): "...Jonathan the son of Shimea, David's brother, killed him."

questions.question: What happened at Gezer?
options: War with the Philistines arose there
questions.correctAnswer: War with the Philistines arose there
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:4 (ESV): "And after this there arose war with the Philistines at Gezer..."

questions.question: What did David do to the people of Rabbah?
options: Set them to labor with saws, iron picks, and axes
questions.correctAnswer: Set them to labor with saws, iron picks, and axes
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:3 (ESV): "And he brought out the people... and set them to labor with saws and iron picks and axes."

questions.question: What is the weight of the gold crown mentioned?
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:2 (ESV): "...and he found that it weighed a talent of gold..."

questions.question: To whom did the giants belong (from where were they descended)?
options: They were descended from the giants (Rapha) in Gath
questions.correctAnswer: They were descended from the giants (Rapha) in Gath
questions.explanation: 1 Chronicles 20:8 (ESV): "These were descended from the giants in Gath..."

questions.question: What became of the Philistines after Sippai was killed?

key_verse_text: And David took the crown of their king from his head. He found that it weighed a talent of gold, and in it was a precious stone. And it was placed on David's head.
